label: Portals and datasets
definition: A structured database or portal read row by row: OECD CRS, IATI, a financier's project or grants database, an open-data or statistics portal.

label: Trade journals
definition: A specialist publication on technology, telecoms, finance or development, such as TechCabal or ITWeb.

label: News
definition: A general newspaper, broadcaster or news agency, national or international.

label: Press releases
definition: An organisation's own announcement or web page: a government, intergovernmental body, NGO, foundation or company speaking for itself, including on a press wire or its own social account.

label: Official documents
definition: A formal document held as a file or in a document repository: a law, gazette, budget volume, strategy, project appraisal or annual report.

label: Research
definition: Academic or think-tank work: a journal article, working paper or policy report.

label: Other
definition: Anything the rules do not place, such as a video, a blog or an unknown host.
